app.integ_mqtt_info_html:
Publishes your heart rate and, if zones are on, the current zone with its colour. Home Assistant picks them up on its own. Game events like You Died or Pentakill come as their own entity, so a light can react to them. Your operating system stores the password encrypted.
How to set it up ↗
app.integ_hyperaid_info: HypeRaid is an addon for WoW Forever. HypeRate writes your heart rate into the game folder and the addon shows it in the game. With Share my BPM in the addon, your group sees it too.

app.sess_live_wait: The curve appears within half a minute.
app.sess_info: Sessions hold health data, so they are only recorded while this is on, never leave this computer and are deleted after the time you set.

app.addons_desc: Small programs of your own that react to your heart rate.
app.addons_intro: Addons are small programs in a folder on this computer. They can react to your heart rate, your zone and game moments, remember things, show notifications and draw in the overlay. Write one yourself, start from a ready-made example, or let a coding assistant help you. HypeRate Desktop contains no AI and sends nothing to AI services.
app.addons_safety_text: Every addon runs on its own in a sealed-off area: no access to your files, other apps or the rest of HypeRate. It only gets what you allow when you switch it on, and it may only reach the web addresses it names. After any change to an addon you are asked again.

app.addon_perm_gameMoments: Read game moments (boss kills, deaths, pentakills …)

app.addons_changed_text: This addon changed and is paused until you look at what it asks for now.
app.addons_plus_sub: Creates a folder with example code and a guide to build it in.
app.addons_settings_note: Changes apply right away and need no new approval.
app.addons_edit_text: Edit the files in the addon folder directly. Or describe here what should change and get a ready-made task you can hand to a coding assistant.
app.addons_create_task_ph: e.g. "Show a notification when my heart rate stays above 150 for a minute"
app.addons_create_hint: This creates a folder with example code and a guide (AGENTS.md), with your wish in it. Then get started yourself, or hand the task to a coding assistant.
app.addons_prompt_how: Edit the files in the folder yourself, or copy this task into a coding assistant that can edit files on this computer (for example Claude Code, Codex or Cursor). HypeRate does not send it anywhere.
app.addons_prompt_after: As soon as the files are ready, the addon's tile shows it. Switch it on there and confirm what it may do.
app.guide_what_title: Little programs that react to your pulse
app.guide_what_text:
An addon can react to your heart rate, your zone and game moments, remember things, show notifications and draw in the overlay. For example: a warning when your pulse stays high, a glowing screen edge, or a count of your calmest boss fights.

Write it yourself (the guide with examples is on GitHub), start from an example, or let a coding assistant help. HypeRate Desktop itself contains no AI and sends nothing to AI services.
app.guide_safe_text:
Every addon runs on its own in a sealed-off area. It cannot see your files, other apps or the rest of HypeRate, and gets only what you allow. Change anything in it, and you are asked again.

Addons are off until you allow them. You can switch them off again any time in Settings.
app.guide_wish_text: Click the + tile, give the addon a name and write in your own words what it should do. HypeRate creates a folder for it on this computer.
app.guide_ai_title: 2. Build it: yourself or with help
app.guide_ai_text: The folder holds example code and a guide (AGENTS.md). Write the code yourself in any editor, or copy the ready-made task into a coding assistant such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor; the guide explains to it how an addon works.
app.guide_approve_text: When the addon is ready, open its tile in Integrations and switch it on. HypeRate shows you what it wants to use, such as your heart rate or a web address. Only allow what makes sense to you.
app.guide_adjust_text: Many addons have settings, such as a limit or a colour, that you change right on the addon's page. For anything bigger, edit the files yourself or create a new task under "Change the addon".
app.guide_fix_text:
Errors show up on the addon's page. "Copy as text" gives you the error with hints, for you or your assistant. The log shows what the addon has been doing.

You can open this guide again any time with "Help".
app.set_addons_desc: Lets addons you made yourself run. Off stops all of them.
app.addon_perm_overlay: Show something in the overlay (a window of its own, next to the heart rate)
app.addons_overlay_text: Shows in a window of its own while the overlay is on, and hides with it (also with the hotkey). Move it like the heart rate widget: point at it and drag.
app.addons_overlay_closed: The overlay is off right now.
app.overlay_show_widget_sub: Off: the heart and the game cards stay hidden, and the overlay (button and hotkey) shows only your addons.
app.preview_no_widget: Widget hidden – only your addons are in the overlay
app.addons_create_empty: Write what the addon should do (a name is optional).
app.addons_overlay_screen: Lies over the whole screen the overlay is on and comes and goes with it (also with the hotkey). Clicks always go through to what is underneath.
app.addons_limits_text: The addon tried these things, which HypeRate Desktop does not allow or offer (yet):
app.addons_wishes_text: WISHES.md lists what this addon would need from HypeRate Desktop:
app.addons_limit_network: Wanted to reach {detail}, which is not listed under "network" in addon.json.
app.addons_limit_protocol: Wanted to connect over {detail}; only https is allowed.
app.addons_limit_inline: Has code written straight into its HTML file, which is blocked: it has to be in a .js file of its own.
app.addons_limit_source: Wanted to load something from outside its folder, which is blocked.
app.addons_limit_permission: Wanted to use "{detail}" without the permission for it in addon.json.
app.addons_limit_message-size: Sent a message to its overlay that is too big (over 64 KB).
app.addons_limit_window-size: Its overlay window would cover more than a third of the screen and was made smaller, so it cannot block the mouse. For effects over the whole screen there is "mode": "screen".
app.addons_limit_cpu: Kept using a lot of processor time and was stopped, so games stay smooth.
app.addons_wish_how: This text says what your addon would need. Nothing is sent by itself: the button copies it and opens the feedback form, where you paste it and send it if you like.
app.addons_wish_copied: Copied – paste it in the form
app.overlay_fullscreen_note: Games in exclusive full screen (some Windows games) let nothing be drawn over them, not even this overlay. Set the game to "borderless window" instead.
app.addons_no_ai: HypeRate Desktop contains no AI and sends nothing to AI services.
app.addons_install_text: Downloaded a finished addon? Copy its folder into the addons folder; it shows up by itself.
app.addons_master_off_text: Your own addons are switched off, so this one does not run. Allow them to use it again.
